purpose: Fourteen public small-RNA runs (SRR28573920-25, SRR8205656-63) that map near-zero against the study's mRNA reference were quantified against the miRBase mature miRNA reference (69,020 entries; salmon index k=19 with --keepDuplicates, yielding 69,019 targets - the single FASTA entry salmon cannot index is ath-miR5645d-3p, a 20 nt poly-A homopolymer). The eight 50 nt raw reads (SRR8205656-63) were 3' adapter-trimmed with the SDK (Illumina universal adapter, min-overlap 8, min-length 18) before quantification; bias correction is disabled as it is not meaningful for small-RNA fragments.

methodology.backends_flag: rust-orchestrated upstream salmon 2.7.0 (bioconda), -l A, -p 8, --validateMappings, no bias correction; adapter trim via linxira-bio fastq adapter-trim
methodology.disclosure: data-property finding: SRR28573920-25 are dominated by 24-30 nt siRNA-class reads (mature-miRNA exact-substring content ~1.6%), and SRR8205656-63 inserts (34-42 nt after trimming) are longer than the 20-24 nt mature targets, so end-to-end alignment maps ~0% by construction - the quant.sf files capture the minor miRNA component; the library-type interpretation belongs to the study

environment.cpu_model: Intel Xeon E5-2676 v3 @ 2.40GHz (24 threads; runs pinned to cores 8-15, nice 10)
environment.gpu: AMD Radeon RX 580 2048SP (Polaris 20, amdgpu kernel driver; unused by these workloads)
environment.memory: 32 GiB DDR3-1600 MT/s (2x16 GiB DIMM_B1/D1, 72-bit width)
environment.storage: system/log: Kingston SA400S37 120 GB SSD; benchmark I/O data volume: WDC WD5000AZLX 500 GB 7200rpm HDD; bulk reference data: Seagate ST3000DM001 3 TB HDD
environment.code_revision: v1.0.3 release binary (workstation deployment, built 2026-09-14) + post-release ops scripts

data_sources.reference: study workspace fastq for SRR28573920-25 and SRR8205656-63 (public NCBI SRA accessions), read-only
data_sources.note: raw 50 nt reads for SRR8205656-63; adapter-trimmed intermediates regenerated per run

data_sources.reference: miRBase mature.fa (69,020 entries, mirbase.org), salmon index k=19 --keepDuplicates
study mRNA salmon index (not used here; listed for completeness of the workstation toolchain)
data_sources.note: the mRNA index is the reference these runs were originally found unmappable against

entries.dataset: 14 runs against the miRBase mature index; every quant.sf = 69,019 rows (full indexed target set)
entries.consistency: 14/14 quant.sf match the indexed target set exactly (69,019 rows); mapped fractions 0.00-0.10% reflect the libraries' small miRNA fraction, documented per run
